answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose the Customized Model Agnostic Meta-Learning algorithm (CMAML) that is able to customize dialogue models ... The focus of our paper -few-shot dialogue generation, i.e. training a generative model that can be generalized to a new task (domain) within k-shots of its dialogues.

answer_2.quote: We performed automatic evaluation metrics in three perspectives: • Response quality/diversity: We use BLEU to measure the word overlap ... PPL, the negative logarithm of the generated sentence; Dist-1 to evaluate the response diversity ... • Task consistency: We use C score in Persona-chat ... and E-acc in MojiTalk ... • Model difference: ... Diff Score ... Δ Score.

answer_4.quote: We invited 3 well-educated graduated students to annotate the 100 generated replies for each method. ... Volunteers, instead of authors, conduct the double-blind annotations on shuffled samples to avoid subjective bias.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators grade each response in terms of "quality" and "task consistency" on a three-point scale (2 for good, 1 for fair, 0 for bad).
